sloka: पार्श्वेषु दारिताः केचित् केचिद्राशीकृता द्रुमैः ।शिलाभिश्चूर्णिताः केचित् केचिद्दन्तैर्विदारिताः ।। ६.५२.११ ।।।।
transliteration: pārśveṣu dāritāḥ kecit kecidrāśīkṛtā drumaiḥ ।śilābhiścūrṇitāḥ kecit keciddantairvidāritāḥ ।। 6.52.11 ।।।।

translations.english: Some tore by the sides of the body, some crushed by the trees, some powdered by the rocks, and some were torn into pieces with teeth.
